scenarios.title: Gateway: JavaScript to TypeScript
scenarios.description: A twelve-language service retires CoffeeScript, moves most of its JavaScript to TypeScript, then adds Rust and Protobuf. Switch measure, grouping and chart in the renderer.

scenarios.title: Gateway: table
scenarios.description: The gateway's counts as a table, a row per language and a column per count, sorted by lines of code. Sort by any column from its heading or the Sort settings; the rows keep one order for the whole transition, changed languages first with Changes first.

scenarios.title: Gateway: Rust first (custom order)
scenarios.description: The priority-order example comparator presents the step that adds Rust and Protobuf first, then CoffeeScript leaves and the other counts resize.

scenarios.title: Languages: arrival and departure
scenarios.description: In the default order Ruby shrinks to nothing and leaves, then TypeScript grows and CSS shrinks, then Python arrives empty and grows.

scenarios.title: Languages: Python first (custom order)
scenarios.description: The priority-order example comparator presents Python’s arrival first; Ruby leaves and the other counts resize afterwards.

scenarios.title: Methods per access scope
scenarios.description: Generic metrics: one bar per access scope, counting the methods that require it. Bars read each entity's data.value and data.unit when the extraction has no line counts.

scenarios.title: Gateway: one revision
scenarios.description: Language counts for a single revision, without a comparison.
